title: smime-tree: verify() returns Ok if any ONE signer passes, hiding other failures
description: VerificationResult::is_verified() returns true if any signer passes. A message with 3 signers where 2 fail and 1 passes returns is_verified()=true. Callers treating this as 'all good' silently accept partially-verified content. The doc on VerificationResult must prominently warn that is_verified() is permissive and direct callers to inspect the signers vec individually for security-critical decisions.
